title: 第009章 真相第010章 三年之约
content_zh:
第009章真相
听到请家法三个字，无论是李家小辈，或是陈默老妈李素芳那一辈，全都面露恐惧。
陈默小姨更是一脸惨淡，可见那家法，是何等恐怖！
陈默大舅李立文和大舅妈王晓云，看着陈默，却露出一脸快意。
那家法，显然比陈默废掉李越丹田更加严厉，否则二人，绝难善罢甘休。
陈默依旧面色淡然，静静的看着李东阳，无喜无悲，那让众人闻之变色的家法，对他来说，根本不屑一顾。
“慢着！”
一声急切的叫喊，从院门外传来，李素芳衣衫不整，跌跌撞撞的冲了进来。
迅速扫了眼四周，李素芳稳定心神，对着那位让她又敬又恨的父亲，微微躬身施礼。
然后转身看着李立文道：“大哥，小默虽然年少无知，但，并非那种心狠手辣之徒，这当中肯定有什么误会！”
李立文悲痛欲绝的冷笑：“误会？四妹，你的亲侄儿还满身是血的躺在那，生死未卜，你告诉我，怎么是误会？”
李素芳看了眼躺在担架上，浑身是血，奄奄一息的李越，即便是见过大风大浪的她，也忍不住一阵心惊，不由得皱起眉头。
但是，她相信自己儿子绝对不会无缘无故做出这种伤害至亲表兄的事，其中，一定有她不知道的原因。
而且对方那么多人，陈默却只有一人，事情的真相早就摆在众人眼前，只是没有人替陈默说话罢了。
“小默，到底是怎么回事？”李素芳转头望着陈默，沉声问道。
陈默原本不屑向李家这些人解释，谅他们也奈何不了自己，可老妈询问，陈默却无法置之不理。
陈默不由的苦笑道：“老妈，你觉得就算我解释，他们这些人，会相信么？”
李素芳明白陈默言下之意，李家人本就对她们母子极为排斥，即便陈默解释，怕是也没人会相信。
可如果不解释，那不就坐实了陈默的罪名？
一旦坐实了罪名，那位狠心的父亲肯定会降下家法。

陈默或许不明白李家家法的恐怖，可作为李家二代子弟，李素芳却非常清楚那家法的残酷，那会要了陈默的命！
“他们不信，我信。公道自在人心，你把事情的经过说出来，让在场的你的这些长辈们，评评理！”
陈默有些无奈的挠了挠头，自己这位老妈，对李家人还是心存幻想啊！
不过既然李素芳让他说，他不得不说。
但，陈默不打算自己说，他准备找个更具说服力的人，来替他说。
陈默的目光扫过那几名跪在李越身后的李家旁系少年身上，突然旁若无人的走过去，抓起一名被他打过的少年，不顾那少年的挣扎，来到李素芳面前。
“让他替我说吧，当时的全部经过，他看的一清二楚。”
李素芳有些错愕，周围所有李家人也有些错愕，那少年分明是跟李越同一阵营的，陈默让他讲诉当时事情的经过，不是搬起石头砸自己的脚吗？
就连那名被陈默抓过来的少年，也是惊讶的望着陈默，不明白陈默是何用意。
陈默淡淡盯着那少年的双眼，眼中忽然浮现一片尸山血海，星辰湮灭，来自灵魂的强大威压把那少年瞬间吓傻。
陈默的声音在外人耳中，却依旧是平平淡淡，可在那少年听来，却如同来自远古神祗，不容抗拒：“把你知道的，原封不动的讲出来，不得有半句谎言！”
那少年顿时目光呆滞，原原本本把李越带着他们，去教训陈默的经过说了出来，连李越骂陈默的那些话，一个字都没有漏掉的讲了出来。
听完之后，原本群情激奋的李家众人，全都陷入沉默。李立文一家，更是面色苍白，羞愧不已。
李素芳气的浑身发抖，怒视李立文，冷喝道：“大哥，这就是你教出来的好儿子！骂自己的姑姑是不要脸的女人，骂自己的表弟是……”
那两个字，李素芳实在无法说出口。
陈默站在一旁，幸灾乐祸的看着表情怪异的李家众人，一副事不关己高高挂起的态度。
王晓云强辩道：“就算李越口无遮拦，陈默也不应该下此毒手，当时陈默分明已经制服越儿，为何还要再次伤害他！”
“再说了，我并未觉得越儿说错了什么，既然你当年做得出来那些事，难道还怕别人说吗？”
“住口！”李立文怒声喝斥，然后急忙解释：“四妹，你大嫂她伤心过度，胡言乱语，你别往心里去！”
content_en:
Chapter 009 The truth
When they heard the words "Please help the family", both the younger generation of the Li family and the generation of Chen Mo's mother, Li Sufang, all showed fear on their faces.
Aunt Chen Mo's face was even more bleak, which showed how terrifying the family law was!
Chen Mo's uncle Li Liwen and his aunt Wang Xiaoyun looked at Chen Mo with happy expressions on their faces.
That family law is obviously more severe than Chen Mo's destruction of Li Yue's Dantian, otherwise the two of them would never let it go.
Chen Mo still had a calm expression on his face and looked at Li Dongyang quietly with no joy or sadness. To him, he didn't even care about the family method that made everyone change their color.
"Wait!"
An urgent shout came from outside the courtyard gate, and Li Sufang stumbled in with disheveled clothes.
After quickly glancing around, Li Sufang stabilized her mind and bowed slightly to the father she respected and hated.
Then he turned around and looked at Li Liwen and said, "Brother, although Xiao Mo is young and ignorant, he is not the kind of ruthless person. There must be some misunderstanding in this!"
Li Liwen sneered in grief: "Misunderstanding? Fourth sister, your nephew is still lying there covered in blood, with his life and death uncertain. Tell me, why is this a misunderstanding?"
Li Sufang glanced at Li Yue, who was lying on a stretcher, covered in blood and dying. Even though she had seen strong winds and waves, she couldn't help but feel frightened and frowned.
However, she believed that her son would never do such a thing to hurt his close cousin without any reason. There must be a reason that she didn't know.
Moreover, there were so many people on the other side, but there was only one Chen Mo. The truth of the matter had long been in front of everyone, but no one spoke for Chen Mo.
"Xiao Mo, what's going on?" Li Sufang turned to look at Chen Mo and asked in a deep voice.
Chen Mo originally didn't bother to explain to the Li family because they couldn't do anything to him, but when his mother asked, Chen Mo couldn't ignore it.
Chen Mo couldn't help but smile bitterly and said, "Mom, do you think people like them would believe me even if I explain?"
Li Sufang understood what Chen Mo meant. The Li family was extremely repulsive to their mother and son. Even if Chen Mo explained, no one would believe it.
But if he doesn't explain, wouldn't that prove Chen Mo's crime?
Once the crime is proven, the cruel father will definitely impose family laws.
Chen Mo may not understand the horror of the Li family's family law, but as a second-generation descendant of the Li family, Li Sufang is very aware of the cruelty of the family law, which will kill Chen Mo!
"They don't believe it, but I believe it. Justice lies in the heart of the people. Tell the story of what happened and let your elders present judge it!"
Chen Mo scratched his head helplessly. As a mother, she still had illusions about the Li family!
But since Li Sufang asked him to say it, he had to say it.
However, Chen Mo didn't plan to say it himself. He was going to find someone more convincing to say it for him.
Chen Mo's eyes swept over the young men from the Li family who were kneeling behind Li Yue. He suddenly walked over as if no one was watching, grabbed a young man who had been beaten by him, and came to Li Sufang regardless of the young man's struggle.
"Let him tell it for me. He saw everything clearly."
Li Sufang was a little surprised, and so were all the Li family members around her. That young man was clearly in the same camp as Li Yue. If Chen Mo asked him to tell what happened at that time, wouldn't he be shooting himself in the foot?
Even the young man who was captured by Chen Mo looked at Chen Mo in surprise, not understanding what Chen Mo meant.
Chen Mo stared at the young man's eyes. Suddenly, a mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood appeared in his eyes. The stars were annihilated. The powerful pressure from the soul instantly frightened the young man.
In the ears of outsiders, Chen Mo's voice still sounded ordinary, but to the young man's ears, it sounded like it came from an ancient god, and he could not resist: "Tell me what you know, exactly, without any lies!"
The young man's eyes suddenly became dull, and he remained as he was.He told them how Li Yue took them to teach Chen Mo a lesson, and even said the words Li Yue scolded Chen Mo without missing a word.
After listening, everyone in the Li family who was originally excited fell silent. Li Liwen's family was even more pale and ashamed.
Li Sufang was shaking with anger, glared at Li Liwen, and shouted coldly: "Brother, this is the good son you raised! He called his aunt a shameless woman, and called his cousin..."
Li Sufang really couldn't say those two words.
Chen Mo stood aside, gloating at the strange expressions of everyone in the Li family, as if the matter had nothing to do with him.
Wang Xiaoyun argued forcefully: "Even if Li Yue spoke freely, Chen Mo should not have done this. Chen Mo had clearly subdued Yue'er at that time, so why did he hurt him again!"
"Besides, I don't think Yue'er said anything wrong. Since you did those things back then, are you still afraid of what others will say?"
"Shut up!" Li Liwen shouted angrily, and then hurriedly explained: "Fourth sister, your sister-in-law is too sad and talking nonsense, don't take it to heart!"
